title: Stop emitting required obligations for satisfied or terminal subjects
description: WHY: reproduced - bwrk summary show on the closed milestone bw_work_ada82d27cb3eef95 emits git.checkpoint-required and closeout.summary-required at severity required even though the subject is closed with a final summary and matching acknowledgements. Root cause is dataActivatesRegistryEntry in packages/core/src/agent-directive-compiler.ts: the closeout.summary-required arm activates when isTerminalWorkStatus(subject.status) is true, and the git.checkpoint-required arm activates when data has non-empty commitShas or dirtyPathNotes - both key the obligation on evidence of its own satisfaction. This violates the design principle that gap presence is liveness: a satisfied gap stops being emitted. The practical effect is recurring operational-note noise where agents are told closeout obligations exist on closed work. WHAT: make emission state-negative - these gaps fire only when the obligation is unmet (terminal or closing subject lacking a final summary; checkpoint-scoped changes lacking both a commit SHA and a validated reason). Where a record-of-satisfaction display is wanted, emit it at advisory severity with a distinct registry id (for example closeout.summary-recorded), never required. Add regression tests asserting that summary show and work show on a closed subject with satisfying records emit zero required or blocking directives.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk summary show bw_work_ada82d27cb3eef95 --json emits no required or blocking directives
Unsatisfied cases still emit - a closing work item without a final summary still produces closeout.summary-required, covered by tests
pnpm check and pnpm test pass
closedReason: satisfied terminal obligations no longer emit required directives
